name: 7 paid apps, free on GitHub
headline: 7 paid apps with a *free version* on GitHub
summary: ChatGPT, Notion, ElevenLabs and four more, each with a free open-source twin on GitHub. Links, what each one does, and the fine print.

sections.title: The *free versions*
sections.intro: Sorted by GitHub stars (Nov 2026). Tap Open to see the project on GitHub.

items.name: Open WebUI
items.what: Chat with AI models that run on your own computer, or plug in a cloud API. Local models need a fairly strong computer.

items.name: Stirling PDF
items.what: Merge, split, compress and sign PDFs, and turn scans into text. Free for individuals and teams of up to 5.

items.name: AppFlowy
items.what: Notes, docs and wikis, and your data stays yours. Its local AI with Ollama is free too.

items.name: Plane
items.what: Tasks, sprints and docs for your team, on your own server. There's also a free cloud plan for up to 12 people.

items.name: Voicebox
items.what: Clone a voice from about 3 seconds of audio, running entirely on your own laptop.

items.name: Chatwoot
items.what: Website chat, email, WhatsApp and Instagram messages in one shared inbox. Some enterprise features are paid.

items.name: OpenWhispr
items.what: You talk, it types into any app, even offline. Cloud models are optional with your own API key.

features.title: Free to use, not always free for companies
features.text: Stirling PDF is free up to 5 users, and Chatwoot keeps some enterprise features paid. Check each project's LICENSE file before you use one at work.

features.title: Most of them run on your own machine
features.text: That's why your data stays yours. It also means you install and update them yourself. Each GitHub page has the install steps.

features.title: Star counts change
features.text: Stars were counted on 6 Nov 2026. They only go up, so the order may shift.
